title: Two teams, one sky
text: Split into two teams. A 5 by 5 sky of words goes up on the TV.

title: The astronomer's map
text: Each team's astronomer sees the secret star map on their phone: your stars, theirs, dust and the black hole.

title: One word, one number
text: The astronomer says a one-word clue and a number out loud. Teammates vote on their phones for which words to chart.

title: Watch out
text: Dust is a wasted guess. The other team's star helps them. The black hole loses the game on the spot!

title: Win
text: Chart all of your team's stars first to win.
